claim: 79 documented operation/RPC rows; 19 complete transport operation paths, 10 complete application operations, 11 partial application operations, 58 unimplemented. No 100% claim; variants, fields and real hardware evidence remain separate.

status_rules.implemented: End-to-end source, service/model, application access and test references exist for every inventoried variant. Actual test runs and hardware validation remain separate.
status_rules.partial: At least one documented variant or dedicated user flow is missing.
status_rules.not_implemented: No current integration path; remains in the denominator.
status_rules.hardware_validation: Per-operation evidence is separate; no hardware command was sent by this inventory.
status_rules.field_inheritance: Every request/response property in api-contract.json inherits its interface/operation implementation status unless a local_fields row overrides its modeling status. Schema presence never implies implementation.
status_rules.schema_reference_resolution: interfaces.<interface>.schemas maps official schema names to schema_catalog facts. REST $ref values resolve in the same interface. AsyncAPI schemas are full field-path inventories from embedded official docs.
status_rules.transport_implementation: Wire-level implementation status only; never an end-to-end application coverage claim.

access: Reachable compatible gateway with Local API enabled
HTTP3000 or HTTPS3443 with explicitly verified certificate pin; no device-side client authentication
Writes require Moli authorization, gateway pilot mode and current capabilities
local.hardware: Webserver, Aidoo Pro or compatible Aidoo family; each field has its documented device/firmware prerequisites and must be reported by the target
local.rate_limit: none_documented; do not infer unlimited capacity

access: Manual Airzone approval of OAuth application, client ID/secret and registered callback
User consent and access/refresh tokens; HTTPS only
open.hardware: Installation registered with Airzone Cloud; per-device fields and user permissions still apply
open.pagination: GET /installations documents page/items parameters, with at most10 items per page in prose; consume every page. Prose calls the count num, whereas the parameter schema names it items.
open.subscription: AZNS registration/subscription and scheduled programming are documented in this interface
open.rate_limit: no numeric global rate limit established by this inventory
open.hardware_validation: not_run; no credentials or provider registration requested

access: Airzone user login yields JWT and refresh token
User installation membership/permissions; TLS verification required
web.hardware: Installation registered with Airzone Cloud; no assumption of equivalent Local API capabilities
web.pagination: GET /installations documents page/items parameters, with at most10 items per page in prose; consume every page. Prose calls the count num, whereas the parameter schema names it items.
web.subscription: Companion WebSocket API provides state events and authentication renewal
web.rate_limit: no numeric global rate limit established by this inventory
web.hardware_validation: not_run; user credentials must be entered in the local application

access: Broker endpoint, authentication and TLS provisioning are not specified by the published contract and require confirmation
Topic prefix defaults to gateway identifier and is configurable in the manufacturer app; never log actual identifiers
mqtt.hardware: Webserver/Aidoo; capabilities are queried by list_cmds/get_devices rather than assumed
mqtt.subscription: online retained QoS1; device status events QoS1; RPC reply destination/correlation must be respected; QoS1 can duplicate messages

access: Web API JWT and installation permission
WSS; respond to correlated authentication challenge within5s; expired/absent token closes with4001
One installation connection per installation; user events use separate channel
websocket.pagination: Snapshot stream ends with DEVICE_STATE_END; not a paginated REST response
websocket.subscription: User and installation channels; DEVICE_STATE initial snapshot plus incremental DEVICES_UPDATES and WEBSERVER_UPDATES
websocket.rate_limit: authentication reply deadline5s; no other numeric rate limit established

constraints: One addressed parameter per command, or the typed target_temperature_on action for exactly on=1 plus setpoint; capability validation and guard required.
HTTP200 alone is not a successful ACK; validate errors, addressed IDs and echoed value
API acceptance is not physical read-back confirmation; never replay an ambiguous PUT
operations.documentation_caveat: Multiple parameters explicitly demonstrated by Change_setpoint_and_turn_on. PUT reuses POST selector semantics; broadcast ACK shape is not explicitly specified.

known_gaps.reason: Only the addressed on+setpoint compound action is supported; other multi-parameter writes still lack a complete typed scope, guard and ACK contract.
Current transport rejects broadcast writes; complete scope, acknowledgements and physical read-back remain unresolved.
Nine Web API read/auth transport paths are implemented and exposed with partial field/variant coverage. Open API, MQTT and WebSocket are not implemented; their prerequisites differ.
Synthetic coverage is not hardware validation of Aidoo, DHW, ERV, IAQ, energy or commands.
